# MacOdrum Library

> MacOdrum Library at Carleton University provides comprehensive research support, access to academic databases, special collections, and library services for students, faculty, and the broader community.

MacOdrum Library serves as the primary research hub for Carleton University, offering resources spanning databases, archives, government information, data services, and subject-specific research support. The library facilitates borrowing through the Omni catalog and partner networks, while supporting open access scholarship and academic integrity.

## Key Topics

- MacOdrum Library
- Carleton University

## Research Resources & Discovery

- [Databases](https://library.carleton.ca/find/databases): Directory of databases organized by subject, type, and alumni access
- [Data Services](https://library.carleton.ca/find/data): Data Services providing quantitative research datasets via Odesi, ICPSR, and Dataverse
- [Archives and Special Collections](https://library.carleton.ca/asc): Archives & Special Collections with Ottawa and Uganda collections for research
- [Government Information](https://library.carleton.ca/find/government-information): Government information resources organized by geographic region and jurisdiction
- [Maps](https://library.carleton.ca/find/maps): Maps collection including print atlases and online GIS resources for research

## Learning & Research Support

- [Research Help](https://library.carleton.ca/services/research-help): Research Help Desk contact information and subject librarian support services
- [Guides](https://library.carleton.ca/guides): Library guides covering subject research, citations, software, and academic integrity
- [Citing Your Sources](https://library.carleton.ca/guides/help/citing-your-sources): Citation guide covering APA, Chicago, MLA styles and generative AI citations
- [Copyright](https://library.carleton.ca/copyright-carleton): Copyright guidance for faculty, instructors, and students on digital and classroom use

## Borrowing & Collections

- [Borrowing](https://library.carleton.ca/services/borrowing): Borrowing services via Omni catalog for books at Carleton and partner libraries
- [Course Reserves](https://library.carleton.ca/find/reserves): Course Reserves system (Ares) for accessing faculty-assigned reading materials
- [Interlibrary Loans](https://library.carleton.ca/services/interlibrary-loans): Interlibrary Loan service for requesting materials from partner libraries worldwide

## Scholarly Communication & Open Access

- [Open Access Support](https://library.carleton.ca/services/open-access-support): Open Access and scholarly communication support via CURVE, CUIR, and OJS

## Accessibility & Support Services

- [Library Accessibility Services](https://library.carleton.ca/services/library-accessibility-services): Accessibility services for students, faculty, and staff with disabilities

## Getting Started

- [MacOdrum Library Homepage](https://library.carleton.ca): MacOdrum Library homepage with access to research support, databases, and study spaces
- [Services](https://library.carleton.ca/services): Main services page covering borrowing, research support, GIS, and data management
- [Services for...](https://library.carleton.ca/services/services-for): Service directory for students, faculty, alumni, and public users
